name: hollow_webs
description: Hollow webs: dark wells of every size, each framed by a bright rim with fainter pockets nested inside it, the web between them a membrane of fine fibres combed off the set, magenta fibres and gold rims on a black plum night.
notes: Round one (077): triage group (8)'s webs, thermal-pockets-25.jpg the default, wallhaven-391g76 (violet_cells) and spellcaster-25.jpg (spellcaster_webs) as palette entries (tone only). Nearest mode: lace_holes (a lace web pierced by holes, each lit as a glass bead); here no bead light: each hole is a well darkened towards its nucleus (an `inside` glow multiplied), framed by a wide inverted-`inside` rim, and the well's convergence count is cut into five sheet rims, so pockets nest in pockets as in the reference. The web between the holes is a membrane of stripe grain at density 24 from the frame's loop and two views, masked hard to the set (inverted de at power 16; at 2.5 the fibres ran across the whole frame as 032's wisps did). Not reachable by one escape loop: the membrane's crossing fibres are three loops; the one_loop formulation is the single-loop answer. The holes are the set's interior, which the galleries lack (lace_holes' notes), so the seats are hand-placed Julia sets at the centre of a hyperbolic component (rabbit, kokopelli, basilica, a cubic and a quartic), whole and about a repelling fixed point, plus lace_holes' kept rabbitbud and basilica2 seats (the formulation rows'); dropped by eye: the airplane (a bare line) and the basilica and cubic fixed points (wells so large they hide the finer scales). Nearest modes considered: lace_holes (named: its what line is a web pierced by holes) and copper_webs (webs over hollows, but a relief, not rimmed holes). Tone, round one: median and p10 hold, p90 and the near-white share miss on 8 of 9 shipped-stack drafts (p90 0.86-0.88 against 0.763) and on both entries' seats: the bright rim and the de core are round two's levers (narrower, dimmer). Explorer cost (080, `style cost`, read beside other Node workers: an upper bound): 42 s as WebAssembly on one thread at 1280x800 ss2 at its deepest kept seat (hand_rabbitbud_alpha, maxiter 2,000), under the 5-minute bar.
